ctx.x: Bobby Troup and his Stars of Jazz. It was under his name and Jimmy Rowles also.
Stars of Jazz was a t.v. show. I guess Bobby was the host for a while. I‟m just trying to figure out if that could have been a t.v. show or a recording date. I really can‟t say.

There are only four sides listed: Please Be Kind, As Long as I Live, Is You Is or Is You Ain‟t My Baby – you go back to Louis Jordan – and Perdido, which was not issued. Only Please Be Kind was actually issued on LP. No, the first three have been issued on Victor.
